# Engineering symbols

What each drawing practice draws, by symbol class. Set `drawing` on a scene to draw it in a practice; a part takes the class named in its `class` field, or the class its `kind` maps to below. Where IEC and ANSI draw a symbol differently, both are shown: set `symbols: "ansi"` on the scene for the ANSI set (IEC is the default). Anything without a symbol is drawn as a labelled block.

## P&ID (`drawing: "pid"`)

Follows ISO 10628-2 symbols, ISA-5.1 tags and lines. Draws water, heat, fuel, data lines.

## single-line diagram (`drawing: "single-line"`)

Follows IEC 60617 (or ANSI/IEEE 315) symbols, IEC 81346 tags. Draws electric lines.

| IEC | ANSI | class | is | drawn for kinds |
| - | - | - | - | - |
| <img src="symbols/Grid.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Grid` | the utility supply | `grid` |
| <img src="symbols/Generator.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | <img src="symbols/Generator-ansi.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `Generator` | a generator | `generator`, `turbine`, `wind`, `turbogen`, `gasplant` |
| <img src="symbols/Transformer.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | <img src="symbols/Transformer-ansi.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `Transformer` | a two-winding transformer | `transformer` |
| <img src="symbols/CircuitBreaker.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | <img src="symbols/CircuitBreaker-ansi.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `CircuitBreaker` | a circuit breaker; drawn open or closed | `breaker` |
| <img src="symbols/Disconnector.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Disconnector` | an isolator; drawn open or closed | — |
| <img src="symbols/Fuse.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Fuse` | a fuse | — |
| <img src="symbols/Battery.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Battery` | a battery | `battery` |
| <img src="symbols/PhotovoltaicArray.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `PhotovoltaicArray` | a PV array | `pv` |
| <img src="symbols/Inverter.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Inverter` | an inverter (DC to AC) | `inverter` |
| <img src="symbols/Motor.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | <img src="symbols/Motor-ansi.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `Motor` | a motor | `pump`, `heatpump`, `fan` |
| <img src="symbols/Load.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Load` | a load: a feeder to whatever it supplies | `house`, `city`, `hospital`, `factory`, `car`, `servers`, `radiator` |
| <img src="symbols/Busbar.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Busbar` | a busbar, drawn as a heavy bar | `busbar` |
| <img src="symbols/Cable.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | same | `Cable` | an overhead line or cable: drawn as the line itself | `pylon` |

## fluid-power circuit (`drawing: "fluid-power"`)
